semiconductor_relevance: Medium — TOYO Automation specializes in robotics and automation solutions that are applicable in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: TOYO Automation Co., Ltd. focuses on providing advanced automation solutions, including single-axis and multi-axis Cartesian robots, primarily for the semiconductor industry. With a strong emphasis on R&D, the company aims to enhance automation efficiency and precision in manufacturing environments.

regional_presence.Taiwan: TOYO has established production facilities in Tainan, enhancing its manufacturing capabilities in the region.
regional_presence.China: The company operates production facilities in Suzhou, supporting its market presence in China.
regional_presence.Japan: TOYO has a manufacturing presence in Fukuoka, Japan, to cater to local and regional demands.
